details: The International Monetary Fund's (IMF) October 2026 World Economic Outlook indicates that rising inflation and interest rates, alongside prolonged conflicts like the one involving Iran, could exert downward pressure on Bitcoin by making traditional bonds more attractive. Conversely, the increasing global public debt might strengthen Bitcoin's appeal as a hedge against currency debasement. The IMF also raised its global inflation estimates.
title: IMF Outlook: Geopolitical Risks & High Rates Pressure Bitcoin, Public Debt Offers Hedge

details: Bitcoin experienced a 2.2% decline as geopolitical tensions, particularly those concerning Ukraine and Iran, contributed to oil prices nearing a one-month high. This surge in oil prices reflects increased market uncertainty and a dampened risk appetite among investors, impacting various assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin Falls Amid Ukraine/Iran Tensions & Rising Oil Prices

details: Bitcoin is currently holding steady above $83,000, supported by renewed inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), notably Fidelity's Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund. This stabilization occurs amidst volatile market conditions influenced by high interest rates, ongoing geopolitical tensions, and the anticipation of the upcoming US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which is expected to influence Federal Reserve rate expectations.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes Above $83K as ETF Inflows Return, CPI Awaited
